faq.question: Is an EV practical in Jaipur?
faq.answer: For most daily commuters under 80–100 km/day with home or workplace charging, yes — traffic patterns in Jaipur often suit EV efficiency.

faq.question: What should I check before buying an EV in Jaipur?
